items.briefing:
A security breach linked to Hugging Face, a popular AI platform used by developers worldwide including in Australia, has raised concerns about risks in AI supply chains. The incident highlights that third-party AI tools your organisation relies on may themselves be vulnerable — something worth considering as AI adoption grows locally.

Australian organisations are also being reminded to focus on AI governance and staff skills as these tools become more advanced. **Practical tip:** Check with your IT team which AI tools your organisation currently uses and whether those providers have clear security and data handling policies in place.

featured.title: AI skills and governance in focus as models advance
featured.quote: Australian consumers increasingly vulnerable to AI-powered personalized scams using stolen data.
